observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same industrial sewing machine motor from slightly different angles.
The motor is beige/grey, with a ribbed cylindrical body and a mounting bracket.
A metal nameplate is visible on the side of the motor, with text that appears to include 'YHNO N 20YR' and other specifications.
The motor has a black power cord with a plug, coiled at the base.
A pulley is attached to the shaft end, with a spring mechanism visible.
The motor is placed on a speckled white surface with a ruler at the bottom edge, showing measurements in cm.
The background includes a mannequin, white fabric, and a table with tools or materials, suggesting a workshop or tailoring environment.
The photos are watermarked with 'AYOMIDE OLUGBODE'.

claims.claim: Neatly used industrial sewing machine motor available
claims.evidence: The motor appears clean and intact in both photos, with no visible damage or excessive wear. The condition is consistent with 'neatly used'.

risks.risk: Motor may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., burnt windings, bearing failure).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the motor running under load, or a photo of the motor being tested with a multimeter or continuity test.

risks.risk: The motor may not be compatible with standard sewing machines in Lagos due to voltage, phase, or pulley size mismatch.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate showing voltage, frequency, and pulley diameter specifications, or a photo of the motor installed on a sewing machine.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or not meet local electrical standards.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plug and cord insulation, showing no fraying or damage, and confirming the plug type is compatible with Nigerian outlets.

proof_requests: A video of the motor running under load to confirm functionality.
A close-up photo of the nameplate showing full specifications (voltage, frequency, RPM, pulley size).
A close-up photo of the power cord and plug to verify condition and compatibility with Nigerian outlets.
response.reason: The motor is identifiable by brand and model, and the 'neatly used' claim is supported by visual condition. However, functionality, compatibility, and electrical safety cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. These hidden risks affect pricing and must be verified before assigning a price.
